title: A follow-up that goes quiet raises an alarm

verify.note: Fails before the change: the drip crons never reported a pass that found work due and delivered none.

detail: The drip crons ping their heartbeat when they run, so a pass with work due and nothing delivered looked the same as an idle one. lib/cron/follow-up-stall.ts names the states (idle, ok, stalled) and the space-drips and journey-drips crons report each pass; a stalled pass logs cron.<job>.stalled and captures a Sentry error. Checked production 2026-11-02: no break behind the quiet. Space drips have zero sequences (nobody has built one), and the journey drip's only open enrolments are either fully sent (the 28-day reset, phases 1 to 3) or not yet due (Hearts on Fire, 30-day interval, next phase 2026-11-06). The last send on 2026-08-13 was real; nothing has been owed since.

verify.note: Fails today: the heartbeat proves the cron ran, not that it sent anything.

detail: The drip crons ping their heartbeat when they run, even when nothing is enrolled. Space drips have no enrollments and the journey drip last sent on 2026-08-13, and nothing noticed. Add a silence check per follow-up (sent-in-window versus enrolled-and-due) and one end-to-end enrol-and-send check for Space and journey drips.
